title: Sustainable Entrepreneurship & SME Innovation
description: Understanding how entrepreneurs and SMEs transform digital, organisational, and sustainability challenges into innovation and sustainable value. Exploreing the intersection of sustainable entrepreneurship, SME innovation, digital transformation, and business model innovation, with a particular interest in emerging economies. My work progressively moves from understanding firm-level capabilities and innovation toward examining how resources, knowledge, and capabilities are mobilised across broader entrepreneurial ecosystems.
quote: Orchestrates university–industry knowledge exchange and translates it into student entrepreneurship, career development, and research impact.
